note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: SpinUp
clips.desc: motor start: angular speed 0 -> loop speed (quadratic), blur disc fades in at the end

clips.name: Spin
clips.desc: steady spin, seamless loop: 1 rev / 12 f; play at x23.33 for 2800 rpm or drive Blade local X from runtime RPM

clips.name: SpinDown
clips.desc: motor off: deceleration to rest (game decel 2200 vs accel 3500 rpm/s -> longer than SpinUp); blur fades out

clips.name: Jam
clips.desc: hard target: blade stops in 3 f with kick-back, arm judder, sparks; held (game jamSeconds 1.2) then released

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
blade_rotation: Blade local X (file/Unity X), positive = front teeth moving down (down-cut, sparks thrown down/back)
runtime_drive: recommended: RRLSawBinding RPM -> Blade.localRotation; BlurDisc on above 450 rpm
